import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_83/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_83/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source0 and Source1 on 'city'
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on='city', how='inner')

# Group by 'city' and 'type', aggregate count of ride_id and average fare
agg = joined.groupby(['city', 'type'], as_index=False).agg(
    driver_count=('ride_id', 'count'),
    average_fare=('fare', 'mean')
)

# Ensure correct data types as per target schema
agg['city'] = agg['city'].astype(str)
agg['driver_count'] = agg['driver_count'].astype(int)
agg['type'] = agg['type'].astype(str)
agg['average_fare'] = agg['average_fare'].astype(float)

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly
Target4_83 = agg[['city', 'driver_count', 'type', 'average_fare']]

# Save the result to the specified path
Target4_83.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_83/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_83/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_83/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on city (primary key)
df = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city", how="inner")

# Group by city (primary key)
# Aggregations:
# - driver_count and type come from source1 and are unique per city, so take first()
# - average_fare is avg of fare from source0
result = df.groupby("city").agg({
    "driver_count": "first",
    "type": "first",
    "fare": "mean"
}).reset_index()

# Rename fare to average_fare to match target schema
result = result.rename(columns={"fare": "average_fare"})

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_83/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
